headline: Approved September 9 minutes and fire chief's report; updates covered recruits, a headquarters roof, and overtime.

# Board of Fire Commission Meeting Minutes

Date: October 21, 2026
Time: 5:00 p.m.
Location: Fire Department Headquarters

- Meeting called by: Chairman Trask
- Type of meeting: Regular Monthly
- Facilitator: Chief Kadlewicz
- Attendees: Jeffrey Trask Via Zoom, Nelson Lopez
- Absent: George Mettey
- Staff in Attendance: Chief John Kadlewicz and Dale Glenn
- Note taker: D. Glenn
- Timekeeper: D. Glenn

## A. Opening of Meeting

Chairman Nelson | Time: 5:00 p.m.

### #1 – Call to Order

Commissioner Lopez opened the meeting of the Board of Fire Commissioners with a verbal roll call of those present, followed by the Pledge of Allegiance and a prayer by Commissioner Trask.

### #2 – Minutes

The Board of Fire Commissioners reviewed the minutes from the September 9, 2026 meeting.

### #3 – Fire Chief's Report

Fire Chief Kadlewicz provided the Board with updates regarding:

- Injured on Duty (IOD), Light Duty, Administrative Duty, Administrative Leave, Overtime Expenditures

### #4 – Old Business

Commissioner Lopez requested an update on the most recent firefighters who attended the Mass Firefighting Academy. News on the newly selected recruits: 3 passed their medical and are awaiting on 2 more. Plan is to have all of them begin in January 2027 and attend the MFA in Feburary 2027.

New Roof on HQ: shingles have been selected however; the suggestion is to wait until Spring 2027 to have the roof replaced.

Commissioner Lopez kudos and recognition for the Open House led by Fire Lieutenant Maria Pelchar and various Firefighters. There were lots of children in attendance. It was a great event and it allowed Holyoke Fire Department to showcase what there is to offer in terms of services.

### #5 – New Business

There was no new business discussed at this meeting.

### #6 – Executive Session

An Executive Session was not needed for this meeting.

### #7 – Adjournment

The meeting was closed

Motions: Commissioner Lopez entertained a motion to accept the minutes from September 9, 2026, Commissioner Trask made the motion and was 2nd byCommissioner Lopez; motion carried

Commissioner Lopez entertained a motion to accept the Fire Chief's report, Commissioner Trask made the motion and was 2nd by Commissioner Lopez; motion carried.

Commissioner Lopez entertained a motion to adjourn 5:12pm, Commissioner Trask made the motion and was 2nd by Commissioner Lopez; motion carried. Meeting adjourned at pm
